tools.name: recommend_countries
tools.description: Ranks the countries that best fit a person who wants to move abroad ("where should I live?", "where should I move next?", "best country for me as a remote worker"). Same algorithm and data as the MyNomadWorld quiz: tax the user would actually pay, cost of living versus where they live, safety, clima

tools.name: country_profile
tools.description: Key facts for living in one country as a remote worker or expat: income tax the user would pay (if income given), special newcomer tax regime, cost of living, climate by month, safety, healthcare, internet speed, languages and English level, time zone, digital nomad visa and residency minimum. Links

tools.name: compare_countries
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of two countries for someone deciding where to move: tax for their income, cost of living, climate, safety, healthcare, internet, time zone, language, digital nomad visa. With home_country it also gives each one's match score from the MyNomadWorld engine.

tools.name: digital_nomad_visas
tools.description: Lists countries that offer a digital nomad or remote-work visa in the MyNomadWorld dataset, with the monthly income requirement, length and family option. Optionally only those the user qualifies for on income.
